tei:div.tei:p: 17) ༄༅/ gnam chos thugs kyi gter kha'i lhan thabs bla ma drag po ki la ya'i gtor ma'i las rim rgyal 'gong gdug pa tshar gcod bzhugs/ 18)༄༅/

chos nyid zhi las ma g.yos kyang*// gdul dka' 'dul mdzad drag po'i sku/ 'jigs byed dmar nag me phreng can// badz+ra kī la ya la 'dud// stobs ldan rdo rje'i tsha ngar gyis// log 'dren tshang tshing bsregs nas slar// grub gnyis yid bzhin re skong pa'i// dmar chen gtor ma'i las rim bshad// de la yo byad shom tshul dang*/ cho ga dngos so/ dang po ni/ drag po'i las dang mthun pa'i gnas su zhing lpags la 'bru tshom bkod pa'i dbus/ mañdza'i khar lcags snod du 'bru nag gi ngar phye dug khrag gis sbrus pa'i gtor ma zur gsum rno dbal can mtshe yungs rtsang dang khram byang sogs drag rgyan rngam brjid dang ldan pa'i rtser sku rten dar dmar po'i gur phub pa sogs kyis brgyan/ mthar zor kong mang pos bskor/ mdun du khrag gi ar+ghaṃ sogs drag po'i mchod pa phreng tshar du bshams/ ji ltar bde ba'i sar stegs mtho bar bla ma yi dam chos skyong gi gtor ma breng tshar mchod pa dang bcas pa dang*/ mdun ngos su brub khung ling ga can dang thun rdzas sogs nye bar mkho ba'i yo byad rnams mthong rgyud bzhin tshogs par bya'o/ gnyis pa la/ sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes gsum las/ 19) dang po ni/ skyabs sems tshogs bsags nas bzung mchod rdzas byin rlabs nas bshags pa'i bar las byang bzhin bya'o/ gnyis pa la rnal 'byor sgrub pa dang */ las sbyor gnyis las/ dang po ni+e ting 'dzin rnam gsum nas bzlas pa'i bar te bdag mdun gyi dkyil 'khor me ri 'dab sbyar gyi tshul du gsal btab nas bsnyen sgrub sogs man ngag bzhin la/ bka' srung gi gtor 'bul/ tshogs byin rlabs nas mchod bstod yan zin nas/ gnyis pa las sbyor la/ bsad pa las kyi sbyor ba dang*/ bzlog pa'i las sbyor gnyis/ dang po la/ thugs dam bskul pa ni/ hūm̐ hrīḥ chos kyi dbyings nas 'bar ba'i sku: bde gshegs khro bo thams cad kyi: sku gsung thugs yon phrin las 'dus:

rang byung lhun gyis grub pa'i sku: bdud 'dul khrag 'thung kī la ya: pad+ma drag po thod phreng rtsal: sku gsung thugs kyi dkyil 'khor nas: khro rgyal ma lus shigs se shig: sku yi gar byed glog ltar 'khyug: khro tshogs lcags sdig rlung dmar 'tshub: gsung gi nga ro 'brug ltar sgrog: drag sngags ser chen thog ser 'bebs: thugs kyi dgongs pas 20) hrig se hrig: byin rlabs char pa hūm̐ dmar 'bebs: sku gsung thugs yon phrin las kyi: sna tshogs sprul bsgyur gang 'dul gyi: rdo rje phur pa lcags sdig tshogs: grangs med nyi rdul cha la la: 'byung po rgya 'dre dam sri dang: dgra bgegs byad ma'i lus ngag rnams: ma lus phye ma dum bur gtubs: srid gsum stong gsum 'ub kyis bsdus: khro rgyal drag po he ru ka: hū ྃbh+yo: nga ni za byed chen po ste: khams gsum ma lus za bar byed: gdul dka' ma lus 'dul ba'i phyir: gdong dmar sha za srin po'i rigs: spu rgyal bod kyi yul khams 'dir: sangs rgyas kun gyi ngo bo nyid: o rgyan pad+ma thod phreng rtsal: khrag 'thung badz+ra ki la ya: snyigs ma lnga bdo 'char dus 'dir: thugs rjes skyob par zhal bzhes bzhin: dus 'dir gnod pa'i dgra 'dre bsgyur: rgya 'dre 'byung po dam sri dang: gnod byed dgregs sha dang khrag: lpags rus klad pa za bar byed: khams gsum 'di na su yang rung: nga bas che btsan su yang med: srid pa gsum na nga dbang che: pho rgyud thams cad nga yi 'khor: mo rgyud thams cad nga yi bran: nga yi sku ni khro rgyal sku: nga yi gsung ni sngags kyi sgra: nga yi thugs ni chos nyid ngang: thams cad thams cad bran du khol: nga bas che btsan su yang med: thams cad nga yi dam la 'du: nga yi bka' las 'da' 21)ma byed: gal te bka' las 'das pa na: khyod kyi srog snying nga la yod: sde brgyad srog dang bral bar byed: rdo rje dmyal ba'i gnas su bsgyur: ma rung mtha' dmag rdul du rlog:

drag po'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: ces bskul cing che ba bskyed/ gser skyems 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐: mchog gsum ngo bo dpal mgon bla ma dang*/ rgyud sde rgya mtsho gnas gsum mkha' 'gro'i tshogs/ ma mgon gza' rdor bdud btsan klu yi ging*/ gser skyems 'di bzhes rnal 'byor mthu dpung bskyed/ gzu dpang gsol ba ni/ bdag ni ma nyes ma yo'o: gzu dang dpang du dkon mchog bzhugs: zhal lce snang srid lha 'dres chod: dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i phrin las mdzod: dmigs bya bskyed pa ni/ mdun du e las srid pa las kyi btson khang drag po'i nang du nriram tri las dgra bgegs de nyid nyam thag pa'i rnam pa can gnod byed thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bor gyur/ rnam shes 'gugs pa ni/ hūm̐ mdzad kyi phyag rgya bcing ste/ na mo/ rig 'dzin rtsa brgyud kyi dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi= dge 'dun gyi= gsang sngags dang rigs sngags dang gzungs sngags dang snying po dang phyag rgya dang ting nge 'dzin gyi bden= chos nyid gdod nas stong kyang chos can rgyu 'bras bslu ba med pa'i bden= 22) khyad par du che mchog pad+ma drag po badz+ra kī la ya'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs bka' sdod dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ bden pa chen po'i mthu la brten nas/ bstan dang 'gro ba'i spyi dgra/ khyad par rig pa 'dzin pa bdag cag yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la snga dgra lag gis bsdar ba/ phyi dgra yid la sems pa/ da dgra thad du 'dzugs pa'i gzugs can sdang ba'i dgra dang*/ gzugs med gnod byed bgegs kyi tshogs dang bcas pa thams cad srid pa gsum gyi khongs gar gnas gar bros kyang skad cig yud tsam la dmigs pa'i rten 'di la khug cig rtsa sngags sham bur/ nṛ tri badz+ra aṃ ku sha dza: dza:hūṃ baṃ ho: zhes lan gsum dang*/ hūṃ: khro rgyal khrag 'thung kī la ya'i:

nus mthubaden pa'i byin rlabs kyis: log 'dren gnod byed rgya 'dre dang: dam sri 'byung po dgra bgegs rnams: gang zhig sangs rgyas bstan pa'i dgra: bla ma brnyas byed sems can 'tshe: yud tsam gyis ni 'dir khug la: mngon spyod tshul bzhin bsgral ba dang: lus ngag rdul du bshigs nas kyang: bdag gi sabasgo ba kun bkug la: ling ga 'di la myur du khug: sdug bsngal nyams su myong bar mdzod: badz+ra aṃ ku sha dza: badz+ra pā sha hūṃ: badz+ra s+pho ṭa baṃ: badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍe ho: lha dang dbye ba ni/ dam nyams dgra bgegs sdig 23)chen 'di: bsgral ba'i zhing bcur gyur pas na: srung skyobs ma byed yal bar thongs: bka' las 'das na brlag ta re: rtsa sngags mthar/ nṛ tri sarba de ba u tsa ta ya phaṭa: gnad la dbab cing rten gzhi bsgral ba ni/ ham̐'u bh+yo: nga ni dbang drag kī la ya: sku stod zhal bzhi phyag bzhi pa: rdo rje lcags sdig phur pa bsnams: sku smad gnam lcags phur pa'i dbal: las byed khro tshogs tshwa tshwa 'phro: bka' nyan tshogs rnams dus la bab: sngon chad ji bzhin dam bcas pa'i: mngon spyod phrin las myur du sgrubs: sdang byed log par lta ba rnams: las byed pho nya'i bshas ra 'dir: sna tshogs mtshon cha 'bar ba yis: gnod byed dgra bgegs lus ngag yid: rdul phran bzhin du brlag par bya: rtsa sngags gsham du/ gnod byed dgra bo'i tsit+ta srog la ma ra ya trig rbad thuṃ dza ha la pa ti trig naṃ rbad dzaḥdza: zhal bstab ni/ ling ro'i cha shas bzlog pa'i skabs su 'bul rgyu dngalhag gtor la bsre rgyur bzhag gzhan rnams hom gzar sogs su khyer ba rak+tas bran la stob pa ni/ hūm̐: sangs rgyas kun gyi phrin las sku: dbang drag badz+ra kī la ya: dpal chen 'khor bcas zhal phyes shig: dam nyams bsgral ba'i mchod pa 'bul: bcol pa'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: maṃ sa rak+ta king ni ri ti khā hi: gnyis pa bzlog pa'i las sbyor la/ dang po bzlog pa'i dpung bskyed phyir bskang ba bya ba ni/

24) hūm̐ hrī: yul gyi ming ni rnga yab gling: lang ka srin po'i grong khyer dbus: pad+ma 'od kyi pho brang du: o rgyan gu ru pad+ma 'byung: khro rgyal khrag 'thung kī la : gsang ba'i mtshan gsol zhes su grags: sngon tshe thugs bskyed smon lam mthus: bod khams kun gyi 'gro don mdzad: da lta gdung ba'i bu rnams la: thugs rje'i spyan ras yangs pas gzigs: 'dzam gling bod khams sems can rnams: skyabs med bdud dang 'dre yis 'tshe: du ru ka yi 'jigs pas mnar: nad dang gdon gyis bar bcad nas: rnal 'byor phyi nang rkyen 'tshe bas: sdug bsngal nyam thag 'o dod 'bod: chos la sgrub long ma mchis tshe: byams pa'i sems kyis bdag la gzigs: brtse bas dgongs la gnas 'dir gshegs: yid kyis mchod yon bzhes slad du: gsang ba mchog gi dkyil 'khor du: dgyes par bzhugs la byin gyis rlobs: dngos 'byor yid sprul dag par sgyur: kun bzang mchod sprin dpag tu med: nam mkha'i mtha' klang yongs bkang ste: bzang ba'i chu sna 'dag chal bdun: kha dog lnga ldan me tog mdzes: chu klu gla rtsi dri bzang spos: mdangs ldan 'od mchog gsal ba'i me: rtsi dgu mdangs ldan byug pa'i chab: ro brgya ldan pa'i zhal zas dang: yid 'ong snyan pa'i rol mo rnams: bla ma drag po kī la ya: mchod pa 'bul lo thugs dam bskang: sgo lnga tshim pa'i gzugs sgra dri: reg bya chos bcas lha mi yi: longs spyod yo byad 25)sna tshogs rnams: bla ma drag po kī la ya: mchod pa 'bul lo thugs dam bskang: thabs mchog yab mchog bskyed pa'i sku: shes rab yum mchog stong nyid mkha': gnyis med rol pa'i byang chub sems: dga' bzhi yab kyi bde stong nyid: bla ma drag po ki la ya: mchod pa 'bul lo= dam rdzas bdud rtsi ra sa yan: mdangs ldan ar+ghaṃ rak+ta dang: sbyor sgrol gsang sngags glu bro gar: ting 'dzin sgom dang lta bas mchod: bla ma drag po kī la ya: mchod pa 'bul lo=

tshogs kyi 'khor lo bla med rgyan: gtor ma ye shes phyag rgya 'bar: phyi nang bcud 'dus longs spyod rdzogs: rgyan ltar mdzes pa sprul pa'i sku: bde stong zag med chos sku'i gzhi: sku gsum rdzogs ldan gtor ma 'bar: bdud 'dul dpa' bo khro bo'i sku: bla ma 'jigs byed drag po rtsal: khrag 'thung kī la 'bar ba'i tshogs: khro rgyal yongs rdzogs thugs dam bskang: chos sku'i khro rgyal kī la ya: dgongs brgyud bla ma'i tshogs kyis bskor: mchod pa 'bul lo= longs sku 'jigs byed thod phreng rtsal: brda brgyud bla ma'i tshogs kyis bskor: mchod pa 'bul lo= sprul sku pad+ma badz+ra rtsal: snyan brgyud bla ma'i tshogs kyis bskor: mchod pa 'bul lo= khro rgyal dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs kyi: thugs dam gnyen po bskang ba'i rdzas: rtsa brgyad stong sbyar bdud rtsi dang: pad+ma maṃ sa rak+ta dang: khyad par rmad byung gtor ma dang: sha chen spos kyi dud sprin dang: 26) 'bru mar zhun chen snang gsal dang: rnga dung cha lang thod rnga dang: 'bru bcud stong sbyar dza gad dang: rnal 'byor tshogs kyi longs spyod dang: g.yar dam sor chud dngos grub stsol: thugs dam bskang bas mnyes pa yis: lha khyod gnas 'dir byin phob cig: khro rgyal byin rlabs dpungs se dpung: mkha' 'gro'i ma tshogs sha ra ra: yi dam lha tshogs shigs se shig: chos skyong las byed khyugs se khyug: gnas khang 'di la byin cig phob: tshogs rdzas rnams la dngos grub bstim: byang chub sgrub pa'i sdong grogs mdzod: sngon las 'phral rkyen bar chad zlogs: bdud dang 'gong po nad mtshon dang: mu stegs rgya 'dre dam nyams kyi: gnod pa'i bsam ngan ma lus zlogs: gsang sngags theg pa'i dam tshig sdom: rtsa ba yan lag la sogs kyi: nyes gyur ci mchis tshogs kyis bskang: mthol lo bshags so bzod par gsol: sa ma ya shud+dhe āḥ de nas tshogs la rol ba lhag ma btang ba rnams skabs 'di nyid du bya'o:

bzlog pa'i phrin las dngos ni: ling ro khrag skyems dang sbyar ba zor gtor la rim par sbran cing*/ hūm̐ hūm̐: hūm̐ hūm̐: nga ni dpal chen he ru ka: mthu stobs dbang phyug dregs pa'i gtso: stong gsum mnga' bdag zlog byed che: bdud 'dul drag po kī la ya: dmar nag 'jigs byed he ru ka: khro rgyal kun gyi mthu stobs 'dus: mi 'dul mi zlog gang yang med: gzi brjid dpal 'bar rab tu 'khrugs: khro rgyal yongs rdzogs gyad kyi sku: khro bo'i phyag 27) mtshan bu yug 'tshubs: sde brgyad ma lus 'dul ba'i phyir: rdo rje'i mtshon cha skar ltar 'khrugs: sku smad lcags phur bgegs la gzir: gnod byed gdon bgegs ma rig bsgral: nga bdag bag chags ka nas dag: rig pa ye shes dbyings su phaṭa: hūm̐ hūm̐: hūm̐ hūm̐: snang srid phyag rgya bzhiru zlog: lus ni gsal stong sku ru zlog: ngag ni grags stong gsung du zlog: sems ni dran stong chos skur zlog: lta ba ka dag klong du= bsgom pa lhun grub ngang du= spyod pa dran bsam bral bar= sems nyid skye ba med par= 'gyu ba dran sems bral bar= kun gzhi chos nyid klong du= dug lnga ye shes lnga ru= dug gsum sku gsung thugs su= tshogs drug gu ru drug tu= rtog tshogs kun tu bzang por= 'gyu byed rtog tshogs lha 'dre rnams= dran shes chos nyid ngang du= bdag 'dzin 'khrul snang ru tra= dbyings rig ma bu'i byur 'dre= ya bdud sangs rgyas re ba= ma bdud 'khor bar dogs pa= nga bdag 'gong po byur 'dre= a 'thas 'khor ba'i chags zhen= bsod nams dam chos bar chad= snyan grags thar pa'i srog gcod= rang 'khrul rnam rtog rkun bu= ma rtogs 'khrul snang bag chags= dbyings rig rdo rje lu gu rgyud: thig le nyag gcig zag med rgyas: 'khor 'das ka dag klong du zlog: e sa bh+yo zlog: hūm̐ hūm̐: hūm̐ hūm̐: bh+yo bh+yo: gzhan yang bzlog cing bsgyur ba ni:

gnod cing bar du gcod pa yis: byad kha 28) phur kha thams cad= rbod gtong thun dang zor 'phen= lha srin sde brgyad 'tshe ba= ltas ngan brgyad cu rtsa gcig= ye 'grogs sum brgya drug cu= gdon rigs nyi khri gcig stong= bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad cu= dus min 'chi ba rnam brgyad= keg chen sum brgya drug cu= byis pa'i gdon chen bco lnga= rmi lam mtshan ma ngan pa= mi mthun gnod pa thams cad= ltas ngan cho 'phrul thams cad= sngon las 'phral rkyen thams cad= srid pa'i pho gdon mo gdon= nad sna gdon sna thams cad= ye 'grogs glo bur thams cad= ltas ngan dgra 'dre byur gsum= mi kha bra mchu shag 'debs= gcan sna god 'dre god sri= dam sel byur gyi sna 'dren= rgyal 'gor rgya 'dre'i gnod pa= dam sri 'byung po'i gdug rtsub= mtha' yi dmag dpung dgra sna= mi phyugs nor gyi kha 'dre= nad mug mtshon 'khrug thams cad= 'du ba rnam bzhi'i nad rigs= bran g.yog bsam ngan sbyor rtsub= gnod byed za 'dre phung sri= srid gsum byad kha langs ba= gnya' gnon ltag bdun langs ba= mi mthun ltas ngan dgra la= ma bu'i byur 'dre dgra la= slob ma yid gnyis the tshom med: sbyin bdag phyi mig lta ba= chung ma snying ring phyir rgyug= phung gsum rgab 'dre langs ba= ma nyes zhal lce 'debs pa= bzlog go sdang ba'i dgra la= bsgyur ro gnod pa'i bgegs la bsgyur: bh+yo bh+yo bh+yo la bzlog kyang bzlog: bh+yo bh+yo sdang 29)ba'i dgra la bh+yo: bh+yo bh+yo za ba'i sri la bh+yo: bh+yo bh+yo phung ba'i 'dre la bh+yo: bh+yo bh+yo sdang dgra'i steng du bh+yo: bh+yo bh+yo byad ma'i thog tu bh+yo: drag po'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: oṃ artsig nertsig na mo bha ga la te badz+ra kī li kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭa: badz+ra mṛ ta: badz+ra su mṛ ta: badz+ra ho ra mṛ ta: badz+ra rak+sha mṛ ta: badz+ra ma mṛ ta: badz+ra k+ṣa mṛ ta: badz+ra yaṃ mṛ ta: badz+ra dhi mṛ ta:

badz+ra mṛ ta mṛ ta ye swa hā: oṃ chu chu ma shag zlog: kha la pa ti zlog: spra'u shi'u zlog: bhan+dha yaṃ zlog: kha ti naṃ zlog: phu sha lte zlog: ma phe sha tse yan pa zlog: oṃ hrīḥdzaḥbh+yo zlog: bdud pra ma ra ya rbad nan: kha la dza ma li rbad nan: ra tsa duṃ ling shag rbad naṃ: shig shig duṃ duṃ rbad nan: tshal pa tshal pa rbad nan: khroṃ khroṃ bh+yo bh+yo rbad nan: rmug rmug rbad nan: tir tir rbad nan: tshal tshal rbad nan: e sa bh+yo bzlog: bh+yo khroṃ trig pa su sha: bh+yo khroṃ shig zlog: bh+yo naṃ rbad rbad: tri pa su: bh+yo shag la ka tring du: bh+yo sha la pa ni te tri a oṃ: bh+yo shag khroṃ tri pa su shag: oṃ hūm̐ trig khroṃ bh+yo: ma ni ma ra ni bh+yo: mar ra du na bh+yo: rak+mo rak+sha bh+yo: te ya rak+ṣa bh+yo: ma ra ya ya ma ra tsa ki la ya bh+yo: oṃ lok+t+ri pā la naṃ: sa ga pa sha naṃ: na ga du du naṃḥ 30)ma maṃ ma maṃ: tsid tsa ra tsid tsa ra: baṃ ru lu baṃ ru lu: rbad tra ko sha ya rbad tra ko sha ya: ho ra hau ra naṃ: tsi du sod tsi du sod: shig lhur gtub: ha la pa ti naṃ: 'khor ba thul: gnod byed 'byung po'i kā bā tsi rlag rlag: gnod byed sha truṃ mā ra ya nan:

ces zlog sngags dpung bskyed la bzlas te thal mo brdab bo/ de nas rgyun gyi rjes chog bskul ba chad brtan sogs dkyus bzhin bya'o/ gsum pa rjes kyi rim pa la/ sgrub zhag rdzogs pa'i nyin rjes ma la/ gtor ma'i lha tshogs rnams la mchod bstod bzod gsol byas la ye shes pa mdun gyi nam mkhar gshegs/ dam tshig pa bdag la bstim nas/ slar yang gtor chen zor rdzas dang bcas pa skad cig gis khrag 'thung pad+ma drag po kī la ya dregs pa lha srin sde brgyad kyi dmag tshogs khro gtum 'jigs pa'i gzugs can srid gsum gang ba nad mtshon dug gi char 'bebs pas dgra bo sgrol ba'i las la rngam par bsam la rtsa sngags la zor sngags btags pa mang du bzla: zor sgo dbye ba ni/ hūm̐: dkyil 'khor phyi nang dam can rnams: sgo bzhi srung ba'i phyogs skyong rnams: gtsang sbyar gser skyems 'di bzhes la: zor sgo dgra bgegs steng du phyes: bskul pa bya ba ni gtor zor sogs stegs la bskul zhing sgrub khang gi sgo yi nang rol tsam du bkod la sman rag bran/ las byang gi bskul ba dang dmigs bya 'gugs bstim byas pa'i gtor ma bdud rtsir spel ba chad tho bsgrag cing dmag lto'i tshul du phul/ zor bskul zhing 'phang ba ni/ phyar dar dang gser skyems spos kyis sna drangs te/ gtor zor sogs khyer/ slob dpon 'khor bcas rol mo dang bcas 31) rting mnan nas 'ong ste gza' rgod drag po rgyu ba'i phyogs sogs gang du 'phang ba'i sar song ste gtor zor sogs bsgrigs la bkod/ gser skyems mchod pa sngon du 'gro nas/ hūm̐: ma nyes dpang du dkon mchog bzhugs: dgra bgegs ma gtogs sku bzur cig: khrag 'thung khro bo'i dmag dpung bskyed: drag po'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: ces bskul cing*/ 'phang ba ni/ hūm̐ bh+yo: drag po lcags kyi gtor gzhong du: 'bru nag gtor ma zur gsum bshams: rno ngar mtshon cha'i tshwa tshwa 'phro:
